items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: He wanted George Hudson -- he was the only trumpet. And I think Milton Thomas(?). We had three trumpet players.

ctx.x: Yeah, he wanted him. Anyway, he wanted nine out of the band. Mostly he wanted the reed section and some of the trumpets. He wanted George Hudson -- he was the only trumpet. And I think Milton Thomas(?). We had three trumpet players.

Anyway, all right. He came down there in a big bus and parked it right out in front of that hotel where we were staying. Well, all right. The taxi drivers got scared, thought we were fixing to run off before we made the money to pay them. So they went up to town and got the sheriff, and had the instruments
